trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the set — all 54 of them. There is no online trophy and no DLC trophy, so the platinum is purely a single-player road. On Xbox the same achievement is called Mythic and is worth 0 Gamerscore.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This one comes from the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Play the story and it unlocks on its own — nothing extra to do.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy, unmissable. The asterisks are part of the official name as listed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. Free roam stays open after the credits, so nothing is cut off. Insider Gaming words this one “Complete Chapter 5” — it is the same event.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “Breakfast Run”. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “The Cartel Heist”. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “Child's Play”. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “Headliners”. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “VCIA Takedown”. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “Operation Savage Glory”. Story trophy, unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The checklist needs 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, all 39 illegal operations, all 8 bank vaults, and Bret's 15 target decks. It is the biggest single award — 100 Gamerscore on Xbox.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist needs 300. Find stunt spots on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, and watch your tally under Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until conditions are met. Track them under Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; some charge an entry fee. Track them under Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 DIFFERENT races — repeating the same race does not count. Most race spots let you hire a car, and the car's Rating matters, so improve it with Mod Shop upgrades. Track it under Activities > Racing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal texts you a fishing spot after you meet him in Chapter 1. Catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg; you need a boat with a fishing rod — hijack one if you have to.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one in-game video game through to the end. Three run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side strand. Lucia only. It starts with a phone call in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand across 7 shipwrecks. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back later, so it is NOT missable. The final mission is “Maritime Disputes”.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2. The final mission is “Hometown Heroes”.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming which ones. It can be done after the story, and it is NOT part of 100% completion.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by shutting down labs in Vice City. Jason only, from Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots. A meditation only counts once the final “zen” animation plays. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and find them on the map under Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: one Chapter 1 morning meditation at Jason's house — Lucia meditates on the balcony, follow her and accept the optional quest — is gone after Chapter 1. PowerPyx flags it; Push Square lists no missables; it is unclear whether the trophy needs it, since it is not marked as a spot like the other 18. Do it when it comes up.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason only, from Chapter 2. WHICH animal triggers it is UNCONFIRMED (PowerPyx). Clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks — which 100% needs anyway — should cover it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets; 100% needs 15. Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward progress. Track them under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up to open it): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Track them under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 in-game Challenges; 100% needs 70. Track them under Progress > Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner along and escape. It is possible once both characters can roam together (Chapter 2). Bank jobs hand out 4 stars anyway.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing the wanted level. PowerPyx says it pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan is enough — you do not have to drive them. 100% needs 200 of 277 vehicles. Track them under Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. PowerPyx notes gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about 1 km away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. There are 8 vaults; 100% needs all 8. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4. Grade note: Push Square lists this as Bronze — an outlier; the starter, Insider Gaming and sixshore all say Silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is fastest.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; 100% needs all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published yet. Do not trust walkthroughs that claim a method; check PowerPyx for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed — no reliable steps have been published yet. Do not trust walkthroughs that claim a method; check PowerPyx for updates.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. The robbery comes back later, so it is NOT missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both make progress. Note: Push Square does not mark this one as hidden.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It comes naturally over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store — a suspicion, not a confirmed method. Do not trust walkthroughs that claim a method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline — a suspicion, not a confirmed method. Do not trust walkthroughs that claim a method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle; PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. That is a suspicion, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences and contacts. It adds up across robberies. The dye pack jammer unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. PowerPyx puts the total at about $160,000. The real estate app arrives in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first — pair it with Little Boxes.
